answer: Sybil resistance here rests on capital locked before an identity may speak: each new agent stakes into escrow, so one operator spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand deposits at once, each held a full epoch and slashed for junk attestations. Attacker cost scales with identity count while payoff per voice shrinks. Reputation deepens like a meadow after a slow tide: vouches accrue only from distinct bonded wallets, so fresh keys cannot bootstrap standing without dragging real money to a vault that stays exposed to forfeiture.
